description: Research a question under a USDC creator-payment budget. Keryx selects sources, pays access tolls and weighted citation rewards on Arc testnet, then returns a grounded answer and receipt. This remote surface uses Keryx's treasury; anonymous research is sponsored, not caller-funded usage. Public research may send your question to our search provider. The source USDC budget is separate from model and search operating costs.

budget.description: Maximum creator-payment budget in USDC; clamped to the caller's tier.

model.description: Optional Keryx model catalog id, for example deepseek-chat.

name: research
title: Research with Keryx
